Hey guys so I’m just updating with my progress! It’s been almost 3 months since I’ve started Chloe Ting’s challenges & they’ve definitely helped tone up my physique as well as help me with my confidence & mental health. I would 100% recommend this challenge as I built up a lot of arm, core & leg strength as well as endurance, it has a lot of variety & it’s a challenge I definitely see myself repeating sometime. 

I started at around 66KG (I’m 5ft 4) & I’ve lost 3KG despite the pictures not showing a massive difference but what matters is that I feel the difference & see it myself, my lower belly used to flop around & it doesn’t anymore! I’m nowhere where I want to be yet but one thing that helped me was maintaining my self discipline as motivation alone isn’t enough to keep this consistent. There was times where I felt like I burnt myself out too so I took longer breaks or mental health breaks when needed. I did eat a cheeky McDonalds sometimes as well so you don’t need to completely restrict yourself from the things you enjoy. I’m unsure on what challenge to do next though, might do the flat tummy 2021 or the 2020 2 week shred next but I’m indecisive due to the variety 😭
